prose.subject: Invoice INV-39083 from Cobalt Catering
prose.body:
Dear Greywater Robotics Team,

Please find attached invoice INV-39083 for our monthly catering services. We appreciate your continued partnership.

Total Amount Due: 9238.50 USDC

Line Items:
1. Premium Corporate Lunches (Monthly): 4200.00 USDC
2. Weekly Executive Breakfasts: 1850.50 USDC
3. Quarterly Staff Appreciation Dinner: 2100.00 USDC
4. Premium Beverage Service: 1088.00 USDC

Payment is due within 30 days via USDC transfer. Please remit funds to our standard payment address: 0xefcffe480b45fae4df32ccac333679699b463504.

Kindly reference invoice number INV-39083 in your transaction notes for easier reconciliation. If you have any questions regarding this statement, please contact our accounts receivable department.

Thank you for your business.

Best regards,
Billing Department
Cobalt Catering
